sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Only obtainable from paid Twitch Drops.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Hot Rod beverage cooler bag is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 49 inventory slots in a 7x7 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Drinks
- Ox bleach
